title: 2025 AMC 8 Problem 7
statement:
On the most recent exam in Prof. Xochi’s class,

• \(5\) students earned a score of at least \(95\%,\)

• \(13\) students earned a score of at least \(90\%,\)

• \(27\) students earned a score of at least \(85\%,\) and

• \(50\) students earned a score of at least \(80\%.\)

How many students earned a score of at least \(80\%\) and less than \(90\%?\)

solutions.text:
Notice that the numbers of students in each category keep increasing, which makes sense because the categories are getting broader.

We want to include all \(50\) of the students who earned a score of at least \(80\%\) but exclude all \(13\) of the students who earned a score of at least \(90\%.\) So, the answer is \(50 - 13 = 37,\) which is choice D.
hints: Subtract the students with scores at least \(90\%\) from those at least \(80\%\)
